title: Control of representation updating by higher-order thalamus enables history-based decision-making
goal: Surpass the source-paper result on the same task: Decode whether an identical tone occurs in a rare or common block from population neural activity, separately with/without PUL suppression (Figure 3C) and TRN activation (Figure 3G); retain both registered perturbation panels.
primary_outputs: Candidate method and outputs for the source task: Decode whether an identical tone occurs in a rare or common block from population neural activity, separately with/without PUL suppression (Figure 3C) and TRN activation (Figure 3G); retain both registered perturbation panels.

Source-paper comparison for Original Figure3C/3G context-decoding ROC-AUC, pending exact author metric and aggregation recovery: Recover the original per-condition ROC-AUC calculation, class direction and source aggregation from the exact author runs before selecting a primary predictive score. The local implementation distinguishes source-auto pROC orientation from fixed Randomised-positive AUC; probability-MAE agreement and perturbation p-values are calibration/descriptive outputs.
success_criteria: Recover the published numeric baseline and reconcile author preprocessing, class orientation, original partitions and source population for both 3C and3G.
Freeze candidate and author-reproduction recipes before final evaluation on the same original support and allowed neural inputs.
Exceed the faithful author decoder by a justified effect with valid paired uncertainty; reproduce the perturbation contrasts without using a larger contrast or smaller p-value as the win.
Retain all original sessions and both conditions; do not claim whole-paper improvement from the existing3C-only probability reconstruction.
Label temporally blocked, session-held-out or animal-held-out decoding as an extension, even if it improves over a rerun author algorithm on that new split.
The bound improvement contract must be improvement_ready and its complete same-task comparison and admission requirements must pass.
Reproduction is calibration only; reconstructing a numerical result, changing the task or split, or achieving stronger significance alone is not success.

episode.improvement_loop: Inactive until source recovery. A future episode may iterate only on declared development feedback inside the original training portion, keeping the same source task and exposing neither protected test labels nor reference probabilities.
episode.candidate_freeze: Commit the complete method, feature/access policy, preprocessing, tuning and seed policy before a single owner-controlled final comparison; no adaptive feedback between sessions.
episode.final_evaluation: Use the recovered original 3C and3G supports and source metric. Report all condition/session results and candidate-minus-author differences. Existing artifact grading remains a separate calibration outcome.
episode.baseline_policy: Recover and independently audit author scripts and numeric paper outputs; retain any source defects and local repairs as declared provenance. A repaired/new-split baseline must not silently replace the original paper result.
